title: Pharmacy Performance Gating Delivery Fee Lookup
prompt: You are working with a same-day medication delivery service modeled on public health datasets (CMS Pharmacy Provider data). The service tracks two tables: `pharmacy_partners` (stores each pharmacy's on-time delivery rating and service area codes) and `delivery_quotes` (stores multiple fee quotes from different couriers for each pharmacy, along with the courier's name and quoted delivery time). Your task is to find the lowest delivery fee quote for each pharmacy, but only if that pharmacy has an on-time rating of at least 3.5 stars. If the pharmacy's rating is below 3.5, output 0 as the delivery fee for that pharmacy. The output should include: pharmacy_id, pharmacy_name (cleaned: trimmed whitespace and capitalized each word), primary_service_area (the first ZIP code from the service_areas array), lowest_fee (the minimum delivery_fee from the quotes table if rating >= 3.5, otherwise 0, rounded to 2 decimal places), and delivery_month (the month name from the earliest delivery_time among all quotes for that pharmacy, using FM format). Order the results by pharmacy_id ascending. Each pharmacy appears exactly once in the output, regardless of rating.

display.context: You are working with a same-day medication delivery service modeled on public health datasets (CMS Pharmacy Provider data).
display.task: Write a query that returns the lowest delivery fee for each pharmacy, gated by a minimum on-time rating threshold, with pharmacy details and earliest delivery month.

table_notes.pharmacy_partners: Stores each pharmacy's on-time delivery rating and service area ZIP codes
table_notes.delivery_quotes: Stores multiple fee quotes from different couriers for each pharmacy with delivery times

output_field_notes.pharmacy_id: The unique identifier for the pharmacy
output_field_notes.pharmacy_name: The name of the pharmacy, cleaned and capitalized
output_field_notes.primary_service_area: The first ZIP code from the pharmacy's service areas
output_field_notes.lowest_fee: The minimum delivery fee if rating qualifies, otherwise zero, rounded to cents
output_field_notes.delivery_month: The month name of the earliest delivery time across all quotes for that pharmacy

field_logic: pharmacy_name: take the name from pharmacy_partners, remove whitespace around it, and capitalize each word
primary_service_area: extract the first element from the service_areas array
lowest_fee: if the pharmacy's on_time_rating is at least three point five, take the smallest delivery_fee from all quotes for that pharmacy and round to two decimals; otherwise set to zero
delivery_month: find the earliest delivery_time among all quotes for that pharmacy and extract the month name using FM format
edge_cases: If a pharmacy has an on_time_rating below 3.5, the lowest_fee is 0 regardless of the actual quote values.
If a pharmacy has multiple quotes, pick the minimum delivery_fee and the earliest delivery_time across all of them.
display.filter_note: All pharmacies are included in the output.
display.order_by_note: Results are ordered by pharmacy_id ascending.

schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE pharmacy_partners (pharmacy_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, pharmacy_name VARCHAR(100), on_time_rating VARCHAR(10), service_areas TEXT[]); CREATE TABLE delivery_quotes (quote_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, pharmacy_id INTEGER, courier_name VARCHAR(50), delivery_fee VARCHAR(20), delivery_time TIMESTAMP);
example_input_data: INSERT INTO pharmacy_partners (pharmacy_id, pharmacy_name, on_time_rating, service_areas) VALUES (1, '  HealthPlus Pharmacy  ', '4.2', ARRAY['10001', '10002', '10003']), (2, 'quick care rx', '3.1', ARRAY['20001', '20002']), (3, 'MediSupply Central', '4.8', ARRAY['30301', '30302', '30303', '30304']), (4, '  Community Health  ', '3.5', ARRAY['90210']); INSERT INTO delivery_quotes (quote_id, pharmacy_id, courier_name, delivery_fee, delivery_time) VALUES (101, 1, 'FastCourier', '8.50', '2024-03-15 14:00:00'), (102, 1, 'QuickShip', '7.25', '2024-02-10 09:30:00'), (103, 2, 'FastCourier', '6.00', '2024-01-22 16:45:00'), (104, 2, 'LocalExpress', '5.50', '2024-04-05 11:00:00'), (105, 3, 'QuickShip', '9.75', '2024-05-20 08:15:00'), (106, 3, 'FastCourier', '8.00', '2024-05-18 13:20:00'), (107, 4, 'LocalExpress', '10.00', '2024-06-01 10:00:00');

composite_moves: join pharmacy_partners and delivery_quotes on pharmacy_id
use ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pharmacy_id ORDER BY delivery_fee::NUMERIC) to pick the cheapest quote per pharmacy
use ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pharmacy_id ORDER BY delivery_time) to pick the earliest delivery time per pharmacy
gate the lowest_fee with CASE: if on_time_rating cast to numeric >= 3.5 then the cheapest fee rounded to 2 decimals, else 0
extract primary_service_area as the first element of the service_areas array
extract delivery_month as the month name from the earliest delivery_time using TO_CHAR with FM format
clean pharmacy_name with TRIM and INITCAP
aggregate per pharmacy_id and order by pharmacy_id

hints: You need to combine information from both tables, looking at each pharmacy's rating and all of its delivery quotes.

Use window functions to identify the cheapest fee and the earliest delivery time for each pharmacy separately, then apply the rating threshold to decide whether to keep the cheapest fee or substitute 0.

The pharmacy_name needs string cleaning, the on_time_rating and delivery_fee are stored as text and need casting, the service_areas is an array where you pick the first element, and the delivery_time needs date extraction for the month name using FM format. A CASE expression handles the rating gate, and ROUND ensures the fee is two decimals.
answer_key: WITH ranked_fees AS (SELECT p.pharmacy_id, INITCAP(TRIM(p.pharmacy_name)) AS clean_name, p.on_time_rating::NUMERIC AS rating, p.service_areas[1] AS primary_zip, q.delivery_fee::NUMERIC AS fee, q.delivery_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pharmacy_id ORDER BY q.delivery_fee::NUMERIC) AS fee_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.pharmacy_id ORDER BY q.delivery_time) AS time_rank FROM pharmacy_partners p JOIN delivery_quotes q ON p.pharmacy_id = q.pharmacy_id) SELECT pharmacy_id, clean_name AS pharmacy_name, primary_zip AS primary_service_area, CASE WHEN rating >= 3.5 THEN ROUND((SELECT fee FROM ranked_fees rf2 WHERE rf2.pharmacy_id = ranked_fees.pharmacy_id AND rf2.fee_rank = 1), 2) ELSE 0.00 END AS lowest_fee, TO_CHAR((SELECT delivery_time FROM ranked_fees rf3 WHERE rf3.pharmacy_id = ranked_fees.pharmacy_id AND rf3.time_rank = 1), 'FMMonth') AS delivery_month FROM ranked_fees GROUP BY pharmacy_id, clean_name, rating, primary_zip ORDER BY pharmacy_id;

_meta.scenario: a same day medication delivery service tracking on-time delivery performance
